The Graveyard is up to six teams, the most it has held all season. The Colts lost 26-3 in Houston on Thursday and the Cardinals lost 34-7 in Kansas City, and at 3-8 both now have more losses than any playoff team has ever had after eleven games. The Eagles were the third team on the line and beat the Steelers 19-16 to stay out, but they're one of four teams at 3-7 that go down with their next loss, and they play in Dallas on Thanksgiving. Going the other way, the Panthers and Commanders each won by two points and are back on the Championship Path at 5-5 and 4-5-1, because the champion floor steps up at game ten.
